To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The image of teaching and teachers is not a simple issue, but rather one that is multi-faceted and complex.
teachers want more control and responsibility for the teaching and learning process, and they want more support for their professional growth.

teachers want to be treated as professionals, they want to have the opportunity to make decisions in their schools, they want to be treated fairly, they want to feel that they are respected and valued, and they want to have their professional development needs met.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the ways in which teachers can work together to enhance their own image and the status of their profession.
the image of the teaching profession and with the ways in which this image may be enhanced.
how the image of the teaching profession is perceived by teachers themselves.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the image of the teaching profession is in a state of flux.
the image of the teaching profession is a complex and multifaceted issue.
there is a need for a change of attitude on the part of the community towards teachers and teaching.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the teaching profession is in a state of crisis.
the image of teaching is not a single issue.
the profession has been given a clear and unequivocal mandate to take action to enhance the status of teachers and the profession.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the image of teachers has been changing over the years.

the teaching profession needs a better way to measure the impact of its efforts on student achievement, and that this can only come about through a better understanding of the relationship between the work of teachers and student outcomes.
teachers need to feel like their voices matter, and that their voices are valued.
